text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin claimed victory in the 
"Japanese Derby." Mejiro Palmer was 
overwhelmed by her tremendous 
front-running pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse echoes with the "Ines 
Call." Moved to the core by Ines Fujin's 
running, Mejiro Palmer joins in on the 
chant without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Daitaku Helios looked back on 
today's race and seemed to have come up 
with some kind of god-tier race plan.
